notes: This minor release adds eight native packs that were source-only, and stays compatible with Bifrost 0.15.3 and later. It is built by the released, checksum-pinned bifrost-semantic-pack 0.15.3 (public commit f7e104a77b4f869f342dd73af0cc622c4a1a0584), the same producer as packs 0.17.0, because a 0.15.4-produced bundle panics Java analysis on released Bifrost 0.15.4 (bifrost-dev#15349). The release index stays schema 4. Added: bifrost.python-httpx-declarations, bifrost.python-aiohttp-declarations and bifrost.python-urllib3-declarations, which activate only on pinned pkg:pypi/httpx, aiohttp and urllib3 versions; bifrost.python-untrusted-parsing-declarations and -summaries (urllib.parse.parse_qs and parse_qsl, zlib.decompress and gzip.decompress); bifrost.node-zlib-javascript-declarations and -summaries (zlib.gunzipSync); and bifrost.web-network-javascript 1.1.0 (globalThis.fetch). bifrost.web-network-javascript moves from schema 2 to the version-independent schema 8, which drops its inner Bifrost gate; its content is unchanged. The other 77 packs keep their IDs, versions and manifests. Not delivered: bifrost.python-requests-declarations (its shards do not repeat the pack activation, which the producer requires); bifrost.rust-core-logging and bifrost.rust-std-io-write (schema 44, which the 0.15.3 producer rejects); and bifrost.node-fs-javascript-declarations and -summaries (review-required, pending an owner decision). Qualification: all 320 open policy fixtures were run on released, checksum-pinned Bifrost 0.15.4 (macOS arm64) with packs 0.17.0 and with this bundle, comparing completion, reasons and each finding's location, certainty and severity, and all 320 are identical. No rule gains qualified-call-locator-ambiguous from the untrusted-parsing declarations. The bundle built by CI matches the locally qualified bundle file for file. This release does not qualify every pack or imply complete analysis.
